roles.name: Lumberjack
roles.source:
# Bring logs back, keeping one hand for the axe.
loop forever:
    walk to the barn
    store everything
    grab an axe
    walk to the nearest tree
    if i can reach it:
        chop it down
        pick up nearby items

roles.name: gardener
roles.source:
loop forever:
    walk to the barn
    store everything
    grab a hoe
    grab seeds
    walk to the nearest empty plot
    plow the ground
    plant carrots

roles.name: waterer
roles.source:
walk to the barn
store everything
grab a bucket
loop forever:
    if my bucket is empty:
        walk to the pond
        fill my bucket
    if there are thirsty crops:
        walk to the nearest thirsty crop
        water the crops
    else:
        wait

roles.name: harvester
roles.source:
loop forever:
    walk to the nearest ripe crop
    harvest the crops
    walk to the barn
    store everything

roles.name: keeper
roles.source:
loop forever:
    walk to the barn
    store everything
    grab hay
    grab wheat
    walk to the cow
    feed the cow
    walk to the nearest chicken
    feed the chickens
    walk to the barn
    store everything
    walk to the cow
    collect milk
    walk to the nearest egg
    collect eggs
    walk to the barn
    store everything

roles.name: composter
roles.source:
loop forever:
    walk to the barn
    store everything
    grab scraps
    walk to the compost heap
    add scraps to the compost
    if the compost is ready:
        take finished compost from the compost heap
    walk to the barn
    store everything

roles.name: irrigator
roles.source:
walk to the barn
store everything
grab a shovel
loop forever:
    walk to the green flag
    dig a channel
    wait

roles.name: porter
roles.source:
loop forever:
    walk to the nearest item pile
    pick up nearby items
    walk to the barn
    store everything

roles.name: Turner
roles.source:
loop forever:
    turn right

roles.name: Not applied
roles.source: wait

roles.name: Walker
roles.source: walk to the barn

roles.name: Weather
roles.source:
loop forever:
    if it's raining:
        wait
wait
